does: Evaluates a spell's SpellRoll condition for one target: takes the spell's roll condition string, applies the cast's spell modifications to it (eoc::spell::ModifySpellRoll::Apply) and evaluates it, recompiled or as compiled; the frame every spell's attack roll and spell save passes on the way to the roll.

evidence.says: calls eoc::GetSpellConditionString and eoc::spell::ModifySpellRoll::Apply, then evaluates through 0xF00090 or 0xFD9FD0
one call per Sacred Flame cast, from +0x3726D47; the caller chains of Sacred Flame's save, Hold Person's save and a goblin's weapon attack pass it at +0xFCE3CF
